Hi Nathan — great to hear.

On the Redwood side, the minimal fields we need to create the vendor master record and enable PO routing are:

1) Legal entity name (exact tax/legal name)
2) Registered address and billing/remit address (street, city, state, postal code, country)
3) Tax ID / EIN + W-9 (or local equivalent)
4) Bank routing + account (ACH) or directions for wire payments
5) AP primary contact (name, email, phone) and AP backup
6) Any vendor code from your ERP and preferred PO acceptance method (our portal vs. email to invoices@redwood.com)
7) Headcount or spend category if you need to be assigned a specific ledger segment (optional)

We have a short vendor profile PDF that standardizes the above — I'll attach it and can pre-fill what I have from your paperwork to speed things up. If your legal name or remit address differs from the W-9, note that explicitly so we don't create a duplicate.

Estimated timeline: if you return completed profile and bank info by EOD Nov 25, we can create the master by Nov 30 and enable PO routing by Dec 6.

I'll assign Marissa to help with the intake and Kimberly for billing mapping.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference
